reasoning_content:
The docker provider label routes use entrypoint `${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT}` which is "web" in no-tls. But keycloak's router entrypoint is `${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT:-websecure}` -> "web". Hmm 404 means router not matched. Let me check traefik API.

Actually keycloak labels use `traefik.http.routers.keycloak.entrypoints=web` now. But the health endpoint router uses `web`. Let's check traefik's api for routers.

Actually 404 "page not found" is traefik's default 404, meaning no router matched. Perhaps the docker provider isn't reading labels because traefik needs to connect to docker.sock and be on the same network. Let me query traefik api.

action.command: cd /workspace && curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/http/routers --max-time 10 | head -c 1000; echo; echo "=== errors ==="; docker logs workspace-reverse-proxy-1 2>&1 | grep -iv acme | tail -20
